questions.q: Where is the village of Dulin Brijeg?
o: On the edge of the Tara River canyon
questions.e: In the video: "Selo Dulin Brijeg nalazi se na samoj ivici kanjona reke Tare" — the village of Dulin Brijeg lies right on the edge of the Tara River canyon.

questions.q: How many residents does the village have?
questions.e: In the video: "Ima samo tri stanovnika, među kojima je i Srđan." — it has only three residents, among them Srđan.

questions.q: What tourist idea did Srđan come up with?
questions.e: In the video: "Šta bi moglo da bude? Konji." — what could it be? Horses.

questions.q: What happened to him in the first year with horses?
questions.e: In the video: "Čak sam prve godine odmah slomio ruku" — in the very first year I even broke my arm right away.

questions.q: What problem does the road he built solve?
o: It's now 9 km to the rafting starting point
No more mud in the village
questions.e: In the video: "A ja sam sada do startne tačke 9 km." — and now I'm 9 km from the starting point.

questions.q: What water temperature is promised in the pool?
questions.e: In the video: "Pa biće tu voda 23, 24 stepena." — well, the water will be 23, 24 degrees.

questions.q: What is used to heat the pool?
questions.e: In the video: "Na drva, hvala Bogu ima." — wood, thank God there's plenty.

questions.q: What advice did Srđan give to people with an idea?
questions.e: In the video: "svako ko ima neku ideju treba da krene u njenu realizaciju" — everyone who has some idea should start on realizing it.

questions.q: Do 2019. godine živeo je u Foči, a onda odlučuje da započne novo *poglavlje* u životu.
Na samo tri kilometra od *granice* sa Crnom Gorom.
Zatvaramo sada ova dva *ždrebeta* koja smo kupili skoro.
Ali vuk je pametan, planira napad, nije budala, ne *srlja*.
Kada imamo ovako maglu ili oblak ispod nas, to je toplotna *inverzija*.
Vrata imamo, ali evo ne *koristimo*.
*Cerada* je, da kažem, stara i mora se spraviti nova.
Prolazimo malu feratu da bismo došli do *ziplajna*
